sample.topic: Lumber Operations Weekly of Vizney Timber, a fictional sawmill business: eight sawmills, four SPF mills in British Columbia and Alberta (Prince George, Kamloops, Kelowna, Red Deer) and four SYP mills in the U.S. South (Jackson, Macon, Montgomery, Shreveport), for Wk 44-26 (Oct 26 – Nov 1, 2026) against the Q4-26 plan and Wk 43-26, in US dollars. One species filter (All mills · SPF · Canada · SYP · U.S. South) drives every view
decisions: Which mills to fix first and what stopped them: the Quick facts tiles, Figures 1 and 2, Table 1
Where lumber is piling up and which product to stop cutting: Figures 3 and 4
How to change the operating schedule for the next four weeks: Figure 5 and band 02
Whether recovery or grade needs maintenance: Figure 6 and band 03
Why unit cash cost rose and whether it is price or volume: Figures 7 and 8

devices.quickFacts: The KPI row, from westfraser.com's investor 'Quick facts' tiles: six tiles in one row (three under 1280px, two under 640px), each #e5f2eb with a 1px #007e3a border and a 12px radius, no shadow. The label in 13px/600 ink → this week's figure in green 32px/600 (Korean 30px), the unit in 13px/400 #595959 and % in 17px/600 green → the change against Wk 43 ('▼ 1.9 vs Wk 43', rust #a75016 when the change is bad for that measure, '▲' green when good) → the IR Outlook's plan range drawn inside the tile: a 1px sage hairline, a white band with a 1px sage edge for the range and a 3px tick for this week (ink, rust when outside on the bad side) → the range and the position in words ('Plan 49.5–52.5 · below'; below · lower end · in range · upper end · above; Korean '계획 4,950~5,250 · 미달') → a 13-week line in sage-head #5d7b59 with this week as a 7px green dot, always at the tile's foot. Hover or arrow keys show this week, Wk 43, the change, the range and the 13-week low–high with a one-line comment
devices.takeaway: Each section ends on the investor deck's takeaway band: navy #39527f, one sentence in white 18px/700 italic (Korean upright, 17px), centered and balanced, with a 64px sand tile (#8d7b58) on the left that rises above the band and carries the section number (01–04) in white 22px/700. The sentence is computed from the data and says what to do, not what the chart shows
devices.schedule: Figure 5, the investor deck's capacity ledger ('+300 Angelina (TX)', '–110 Lake Butler (FL)') laid on the calendar: one row per mill grouped by species (the group name in green 700 caps), 28 day columns for Wk 45–48 under the week name, its dates and the day letters, Mon–Fri base cells in kraft #e5ddce with 2px gaps, week dividers in #e6e6e6. A down day is a solid rust #a75016 block with the volume in white in parentheses ('(1.2)'); an extra shift is an outlined block (#e5f2eb fill, 1.5px #2d723c edge) with the volume in green ('+0.5'). Thanksgiving is shared by the four SYP mills and labelled over their group. The right column totals each mill's four weeks; the last row nets each week and all four. Labels hide when a block is narrower than its value; under 640px the day letters, dates and in-block labels drop and mill names shorten; the tooltip lists every change with its day and reason

parts.header: westfraser.com's header: white, a 1px #eeeeee rule; 'Vizney Timber · Wk 44-26 · Oct 26 – Nov 1, 2026' in 13.5px, the report name in green 28px/700 like an IR slide title; at the right, where the site shows its share price ('TSE WFG.TO $95.74'), a lumber price ticker ('SPF 2x4 $468 ▼6 · SYP 2x4 $412 ▲9', the label 600, US$/Mfbm under it), then EN/KO as 8px pills
parts.menu: The species filter as westfraser.com's main menu: 15.5px/600 #595959 items, the selected one a light-green pill (#e5f2eb, text #00642e, 8px radius, 38px high), the mill count after each name; 'Against plan and Wk 43-26' at the right
parts.slide: Every section reads as one IR slide: a green 24px/700 slide title with a gray kicker, a kraft #f3f0e9 body (West Fraser sandy brown 100) holding white panels with 16px gaps, the navy takeaway band, then the footnote in 12px
parts.boards: The material is lumber, drawn as shapes and colors only (no grain, no photos, no texture). A bar is laid board by board: one board per unit (1 MMfbm in Figure 1, 2 hours in Figure 2, one day of shipments in Figure 3), 2px white gaps between boards, square ends. The last board is cut at the value; a remainder under 0.35 of a board joins the board before it, so no sliver shows and the length still equals the value. Exceptions are rust #c06228, the rest pine #d3c5a9 (sandy brown 300), and every bar carries its value
parts.downtime: Figure 2: unplanned downtime by cause in boards of 2 hours, causes of a shift or more in rust, the rest pine, a dashed #595959 line at one shift (8 h); the cause in 13px/600 with its mills under it in 11.5px, the hours at the bar end; ticks every 4 hours
parts.yard: Figure 3: the yard as one stack of boards per mill, one board per day of shipments, grouped SPF | SYP under green group names, inside the 9–12 day target band (#f0f5ef, dashed #595959 edges); boards above the 12-day ceiling are rust, and the boards missing to the 9-day floor are dashed rust (#a75016) outlines. The value sits on the stack, the mill and its state under it. When the mill names no longer fit under the stacks, the stacks lie down as rows
parts.unitEnd: Figure 4: a wrapped lumber unit seen from its end, 10 × 10 board ends (3.5:1.5) with 2px gaps, one end per 1% of the yard (largest remainder, so a unit always holds 100), filled from the bottom row: 2x4 up to its share of open orders in walnut #5c4e36, 2x4 above that share in rust, other products in pine. One unit per species, at most 380px wide, with a Product · Yard · Orders list under it (the over-weight row in rust); hover or arrow keys pick out one product's ends
parts.irTable: Table 1: border-spacing 2px on white, sage head row (#5d7b59, white 700, the first cell italic), column tints darker to the right (#e6e7e6 → #dbdeda → #d2d8d1 → #c9d2c8 → #b8c6b7), subtotal rows (species) in 700, indented mill rows, the state in a smaller gray '(BC)', ▼ before a figure under its target, a centered vs-plan bar, negatives in parentheses, a sand Comments head (#836f47); columns drop with width (Wk 43 and inventory under 1024px, Comments under 900px, plan, LRF and grade under 640px)
parts.figure: Panels: white, no shadow, no radius. Figure number in green 12px/700 caps → the finding as the title (17px/600 ink) → the chart title in 13px/700 with the unit in 400 '(MMfbm, Wk 44-26)' → keys with swatches drawn like the marks (three boards, a stack, a unit end, an outline) → plot → note in 12px
parts.bridge: Figure 7, the MD&A's variance table drawn as a plank bridge: Wk 43-26 and Wk 44-26 cash cost as pine totals on an axis cut below its first tick (two white slashes near the foot), fibre → labour → energy → maintenance and supplies as floating steps (rust up, green #418d50 down) joined by dotted connectors, the signed step above each, the Q4-26 plan dashed across with its value in the key, and each step's reason in up to three lines under its name (short names on phones); steps add up after rounding to $0.1
parts.smallMultiples: Figure 8, the annual report's small multiples by week: one panel per species on a shared scale, earlier weeks as a gray #a3a3a3 line, the last segment and dot in green, the Q4-26 plan dashed; the panel name left and its latest value with the plan right; panel heads and plots align across panels
parts.dotTable: Figure 6: recovery and grade as dots against the species target band (#e1ebdf with a #b9cfb6 edge), the gap to the band's lower edge on the axis, the value next to its dot, rust below target; side by side when wide, stacked under 600px
parts.buttons: westfraser.com pills: 100px radius, 36px high (32px small), 15px/400 with .025em tracking; filled green #007e3a with white, or white with a green 1px border; hover #00642e or #e5f2eb
parts.tooltip: White, 1px #d9d9d9 border, 8px radius, the site's soft shadow (0 2px 16px rgba(38,38,38,.12)); the name in 13px/700, the reason in 12px gray, then value–label rows with a swatch shaped like the mark
parts.footer: Kraft #f3f0e9 with a 3px green top rule, like westfraser.com's green footer band reduced to a rule

validation.tool: dataviz validate_palette.js (OKLab), mode light, on the panel #ffffff; 2026-11-07, wood colors 2026-11-11
validation.categorical: West Fraser's charts lead with green and put the past in gray (annual report: five-year bars in #58595b, the current year #007941), with earth tones for segments (IR: sage, earth orange, sand, sky). The subject is #418d50, one step lighter and sager than the UI green #007e3a; then sky #3797c6 and plum #8c5087. All pairs: CVD worst 12.0 (deutan, plum↔green), tritan 8.0, normal-vision worst 17.0 (sky↔green); contrast 4.08, 3.34 and 5.81:1 on white. On this screen most marks are wood: the exception in rust and the rest in pine, with walnut as the one second step
validation.wood: Pine #d3c5a9 (sandy brown 300) is the neutral 'rest' and walnut #5c4e36 (between sandy brown 600 and 900) the base; both are neutral by design, so the chroma and lightness checks do not apply and only separation is checked. All pairs of walnut, rust #c06228 and pine: CVD worst 13.0 (protan, rust↔walnut), tritan 21.7, normal-vision worst 19.8; rust↔pine CVD 23.2, normal 25.4; pine↔green #418d50 CVD 21.8, normal 27.1. Pine is 1.7:1 on white, so every pine mark carries its value or sits in a list. Sandy brown 500 #a8936a and 600 #8d7b58 fail the normal-vision floor against rust (12.0 and under) and are not used for data
validation.other: #d3c5a9 pine is the 'rest' color in bars, stacks and the unit end; at 1.7:1 it always comes with value labels, a list or a table
validation.comparison: #595959 for plans and thresholds: a 2px #333333 tick in Figure 1, dashed (4 3) at one shift in Figure 2 and at the 9 and 12-day edges in Figure 3, dashed (5 4) in Figures 7 and 8, named in the keys; 7.0:1
validation.below: Below plan, over the ceiling or a cost increase is West Fraser's earth orange #c06228 (4.18:1), not red; #a75016 for small marks, outlines and text. Against the subject green #418d50 it is CVD 6.3 (deutan, WARN), so where they meet (Figure 7) every step is signed and placed up or down
validation.schedule: Figure 5's two marks differ in shape as well as hue: solid #a75016 takes volume down (white label 5.52:1), an outlined #e5f2eb block with a #2d723c edge adds it (green label 6.37:1). As fills they are CVD 41.9 apart; as hues #a75016↔#2d723c only 5.0, so the fill, the sign and the label carry direction, never the hue alone. The kraft base cells #e5ddce sit 5.6 from the extra fill and never touch it (extra shifts fall on Saturdays)
validation.history: #a3a3a3 (grey 500) for earlier weeks as a line: CVD 13.4, normal 18.1 against the subject green; 2.52:1, so the latest value is printed in the panel head and every week is in the tooltip and a table
validation.sequential: one green hue #8ec294 → #20562b: monotone lightness, every gap ≥ 0.06, light end 2.04:1, hue spread 1°
validation.diverging: rust arm #e49f75 → #a14e1c (light end 2.21:1, hue spread 4°) and blue arm #8ab8e0 → #295e90 (2.10:1, 5°) around #e6e6e6; poles CVD 17.3 (protan), normal 22.6. A green–orange diverging scale fails (5.5) and is not used
validation.status: good #00642e (7.34:1), bad #a75016 (5.52:1) as text on white; on the table tints good #195c2e and bad #853900 (≥ 4.5:1 on #b8c6b7); on the tiles bad #a75016 4.8:1 and #853900 7.1:1 on #e5f2eb. Status always carries a sign, parentheses, ▼ or a word
validation.text: label steps: green #2d723c 5.86:1, sky #0479a6 4.89:1, plum #8c5087 5.81:1; ink #333333 12.6:1, body #595959 7.0:1 (6.2:1 on kraft), muted #666666 5.74:1 (5.05:1 on kraft); tile figures #007e3a 4.51:1 on #e5f2eb; white on sage-head 4.73:1, on sand-head 4.85:1, on navy 7.81:1, on #a75016 5.52:1

code.note: a white code pane with the screen's own text steps (navy keyword, green string, rust number, plum function), all ≥ 4.5:1 on white; the highlighted line is the light green of the selected menu pill

sans.role: everything. westfraser.com sets Open Sans 400/600 (700 declared), an open typeface, so the English screen uses it as is; the IR deck's Arial and the annual report's Helvetica Neue are not used. There is no Korean westfraser.com, so Korean uses Pretendard, upright where English is italic

mono.role: code and file names in How it's built only; figures on the screen stay in Open Sans with tabular numerals

tileValue.note: Quick facts, like westfraser.com's 32px/600 'US$129'; the unit 13px/400 #595959, % 17px/600 green; Korean 30px; 28–30px from 1023 to 1359px, 25px on phones

chartTitle.note: the unit after it in 400 #595959, in parentheses

axis.note: values beside marks 12.5px, 600 for exceptions and totals; 11.5px inside schedule blocks

layout.header: 76px white header (sample name, period, report name; the lumber price ticker; EN/KO) + 54px species menu
rows: 01 Wk 44-26 versus Wk 43-26: six Quick facts tiles; Figure 1 production vs plan by mill in boards (7fr) beside Figure 2 downtime by cause (5fr), bottoms aligned; band 01; the plan note
02 Running to demand: Figure 3 the yard as board stacks (7fr) beside Figure 4 the unit end (5fr), bottoms aligned; Figure 5 the operating schedule across; band 02
03 Mill results: Table 1 across, then Figure 6 recovery and grade against target across; band 03
04 Unit cash cost: Figure 7 the plank bridge (7fr) beside Figure 8 cash cost by week (5fr); band 04
05 How it's built: the package, Figure 1 drawn step by step with the checks, the code in five tabs
06 How the numbers are counted: terms and sources in two columns
footer: VIZNEY STYLES · 07 with the catalog link, sample note, notice, the back link
layout.responsive: 1360px and up as above with 32px margins; 1280–1359px the same with 24px margins and smaller tile figures; under 1280px the tiles go three to a row; under 1024px every 7fr | 5fr pair stacks and table columns drop; Figure 3's stacks lie down as rows when mill names no longer fit under them; under 640px one column with 16px margins, two tiles to a row, the unit ends and the cost panels stack, Figure 5 drops its day letters and block labels, Figure 7 uses short step names

motion.grow: 0.45s, boards and stacks rise from their base one mill after another (40–45ms apart)
motion.drop: 0.28s, unit ends drop in row by row

tableau.fonts: Open Sans for text if it is installed on authoring and viewing machines and the server; otherwise Tableau Book
tableau.notes: Boards: give the data one row per board (board_mmfbm = 1, the last board the remainder) and stack a bar by [board] with a white mark border, so 2px gaps show between boards; color by [vs_plan_mmfbm] < 0 (#c06228) or not (#d3c5a9); the plan as a per-cell reference line (solid 2px #333333, no label); sort by the gap. Stacks in Figure 3 are the same with one board per day, vertical. The unit end is a 10 × 10 grid of squares from a 100-row scaffold, colored walnut #5c4e36, rust and pine. The schedule is a Gantt bar per change on a day axis. Tables: header shading #5d7b59 with white bold text, the Comments header #836f47, column shading #e6e7e6 → #b8c6b7, number format #,##0.0;(#,##0.0). Finding as the title, the chart title with the unit as the subtitle. Quick facts tiles as text tables on #e5f2eb with a green border; the takeaway band as a text object on navy #39527f, white bold italic

powerbi.notes: Boards: a stacked bar chart with one measure per board (board 1 … board 8, 1 MMfbm each), each series colored by rule (vs_plan_mmfbm < 0 → #c06228, otherwise #d3c5a9), bar borders white 2px; the plan as error bars with dash markers #333333. Quick facts as card visuals on #e5f2eb with a 1px #007e3a border and 12px corners, the figure 32pt semibold green. Table and matrix headers #5d7b59 with white bold text; negatives as (#,0.0); the takeaway band as a text box on navy #39527f

measured.web: westfraser.com (Drupal + Tailwind): body 16/21.76px Open Sans #595959 on white; headings #333333 600 (64/76.8, 32/38.4, 28/33.6, 20/24px); CSS custom properties for green (100 #e5f2eb … 500 #007e3a, 600 #00642e, 700 #004b22), grey (100 #f2f2f2, 200 #e6e6e6, 300 #bfbfbf, 500 #a3a3a3, 700 #595959, 800 #333333), sage-green (50 #f0f5ef, 100 #e1ebdf, 300 #b9cfb6, 500 #749470), earth-orange (500 #c06228, 600 #a75016), sandy-brown (20 #eee9e1, 100 #f3f0e9, 200 #e5ddce, 300 #d3c5a9, 500 #a8936a, 600 #8d7b58, 900 #322e26), warm-grey (500 #b5c1b7), navy (500 #39527f), sky-blue (500 #3797c6, 600 #0479a6); the main menu 16px/600 with the current item as a #e5f2eb pill (8px radius, text #00642e); pill buttons (100px radius, 34px, 16px/400, .4px tracking), filled #007e3a or outlined; a share ticker in the header ('TSE WFG.TO $95.74 · NYSE WFG $67.86'); the investors page's 'Quick facts': tiles four to a row with 32px gaps, 24px padding, 12px radius, a 1px #007e3a border on #e5f2eb, the number 32/38.4px 600 green ('US$129') over a 16px #595959 caption; borders mostly 1px #eeeeee; shadow 0 2px 16px rgba(38,38,38,.08); a green footer. Canadian spelling (fibre, labour)
measured.irDeck: Q3 2026 investor presentation (November 2026, 960 × 540 slides): green bold slide titles; tables with a sage head row (#749370, white bold, the first cell italic 'US$ millions unless otherwise indicated'), a sand Comments head (#a8936a), column tints #e6e7e6 → #dbdeda → #c9d2c8 → #b8c6b7 with white gaps, negatives as (26), units in the row label ('(MMfbm)'); the '2026 Outlook' with forecast ranges and Commentary, and cost lines (Fibre, Transportation, Labour, Resin) with earth-orange arrows; a navy takeaway band (#39527f, bold italic white) with a sand or sage tile at its left; segment panels in sage, earth orange, sand and sky; the 'Continuous Portfolio Optimization' ledger ('+300 Angelina (TX) acquisition' green, '–110 Lake Butler (FL) indefinite curtailment' orange); bar charts with a dashed average line labelled at the end and a 'Source:' line
measured.mdna: Q3-26 management's discussion and analysis: period labels Q3-26, Q2-26, YTD-26; '$ millions unless otherwise indicated'; SPF (MMfbm) and SYP (MMfbm) production and shipments; an adjusted EBITDA variance table (comparative period → price → volume → changes in costs → inventory write-downs → other → current period); words such as unit manufacturing costs, log costs, freight, operating schedules, operating rates, curtailment, downtime, run mills to demand
measured.annualReport: Annual Report 2025 (March 2026): five-year small multiples with past years in dark gray (#58595b) and the current year in green (#007941), a bold title with the unit as a subtitle ('in MMfbm'); big numbers in a thin weight ('275 MMfbm Capacity')
measured.sustainability: Sustainability Report 2025: goal status legend Complete · On Track · Not On Track · Not Complete in green and orange; highlight tiles with an arrow and a short line ('↓25% in Scope 1 and 2 emissions')
measured.realWorld: wrapped lumber units on trucks, railcars and yards (white wrap with repeating logo marks): seen, not used.
